name: janua
description: The open-source, self-hosted alternative to Auth0. A complete sovereign identity provider featuring Enterprise SSO, SCIM, MFA, Passkeys, and Social Login—without the "Active User" pricing cliff. AGPL-3.0 licensed, OIDC compliant, and designed to drop into any stack with zero friction. Stop renting your own user data.

paragraphs: Janua is the ecosystem identity provider. Keep examples placeholder-only; do not commit or paste user records, OAuth client secrets, session/refresh/access tokens, JWKS/private keys, MFA/passkey/backup-code material, SAML/SCIM metadata, webhook payloads, migration exports, database URLs, npm tokens, GitHub tokens, or production credentials.

MADFAM-ENCLII-FIRST-LEGACY-RAW v1: This document contains legacy raw infrastructure command examples. Routine production operations must use Enclii web, API, or CLI. Treat raw kubectl, helm, SSH, provider CLI/API, docker exec, and direct container access as platform bootstrap or documented break-glass only, and record any missing Enclii adapter gap.
The Auth0 alternative you can run on your own infrastructure. Zero per-user pricing. Complete control. Currently in private alpha.
features: Self-hosted OAuth2/OIDC identity provider (authorization code + PKCE)
OpenID Connect discovery (/.well-known/openid-configuration) and published JWKS
RS256-signed JWTs — verify tokens anywhere against our public keys
OAuth 2.0 social login (Google, GitHub, Microsoft, Apple, Discord, Twitter, LinkedIn, Slack)

❌ Managed SaaS hosting (self-host only - that's the point)
If you're paying $2,000-5,000/month for Auth0 (or more with SSO/SCIM), you can migrate to self-hosted Janua and run it for $170/month.
